name: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct-Thinking-Claude-High-Reasoning
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
license: LFM Open License 1.0 (inherited from base; card declares no license field)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Fine-tune of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct on TeichAI/claude-4.5-opus-high-reasoning-250x, adding a visible thinking block for creative-writing prompts. Same 1.170B tensor set as the base. Recorded because the card prints a base block and a this-model block over the same seven benchmarks: HellaSwag 0.486 -> 0.558, ARC-Easy 0.426 -> 0.519, PIQA 0.687 -> 0.729, Winogrande 0.538 -> 0.571, ARC-Challenge 0.365 -> 0.397, BoolQ 0.717 -> 0.722, and OpenBookQA 0.382 -> 0.366 (a loss). Two limits: the block is a Nightmedia zero-shot run with no stated harness settings or shot count, and the card's own framing is 'slightly experimental' with recommended sampler settings - so the +9.3pp on ARC-Easy is plausible but the 0.5pp BoolQ move is noise. General-knowledge MCQ gains on a creative-writing fine-tune is an odd result that the card does not explain; the honest read is 'did not damage the base, slightly improved on these runs'.

benchmarks.name: HellaSwag
